name: reasoning_basic
description: Short reasoning questions with exact answers.

cases.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements? Answer in big-O notation only.
Which HTTP status code means 'Too Many Requests'? Answer with the number only.
A service handles 120 requests per second. How many requests does it handle in 5 minutes? Answer with the number only.
If all services behind the load balancer are healthy and one of them fails its health check, how many unhealthy services are there? Answer with the number only.
